steps.caption: Open Research from the More menu.
The banner says web research is off (no AI key) — only pasted news and your own data are used.
The counters: companies watched, research due now, and AI spend this month.
'Is this a potential client?' scores one company out of 100. Pick Zentrix Analytics.
The result: a score out of 100, scored from your records because AI is not connected.
Live research lists each run — what was searched and which sites gave evidence.
To keep researching it on a schedule, add it to the watchlist.
Zentrix is now watched. Open it to see its research dossier.
The dossier page. Paste evidence first — sections without evidence will say 'unknown'.
Add the link and publication date, so anyone can check it later.
Watchlist tier sets how often it is re-researched: weekly, monthly or quarterly.
Detect signals checks the stored evidence for expansion, hiring, funding and similar — as hypotheses.
Generate (or refresh) the dossier from everything on file.
Each section lists its sources and dates; missing ones say 'unknown'.
Evidence on file: every item with its source and date.
